This leaf is found chiefly in hot and humid climates, especially in jungles and rainforests, and is best known in south-western Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains very hard to find.

A Witan leaf removes two rounds of stun when eaten and remains potent for about two weeks after harvesting. Repeated use may lead to habituation. Its effects concern recovery from stun, not an automatic restoration of concussion hits.
